NOTE 3 - ACQUISITIONS EKS Transaction On August 17, 2026, MiX Telematics Enterprise SA (Pty) Ltd (“MiX Enterprise”), a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, entered into a restructuring arrangement involving EKS Vehicle Tracking Proprietary Limited (“EKS”), the MiX AFSOL TMS Trust (the “Trust”), and certain existing shareholders and related parties of EKS, pursuant to which all outstanding shares of EKS were transferred to the Trust (the “EKS Transaction”). MiX Enterprise and AFSOL TMS Proprietary Limited (“AFSOL TMS”) are the beneficiaries of the Trust and, subject to the terms of the Trust deed, are entitled to 70 % and 30 %, respectively, of residual income distributed by the Trust. MiX Enterprise is also entitled to certain other economic benefits arising from the EKS shares that are not shared with AFSOL TMS. 11 The Company determined that EKS meets the definition of a business under ASC 805, Business Combinations. The Company also evaluated the Trust and EKS under ASC 810, Consolidation, and concluded that both the Trust and EKS are variable interest entities. The Company determined that MiX Enterprise is the primary beneficiary of both entities because it has the power to direct the activities that most significantly affect their economic performance and has economic interests that could potentially be significant to the respective entities. The Company accounted for EKS as a business combination using the acquisition method of accounting pursuant to ASC 805 upon obtaining control effective August 17, 2026. Allocation of Purchase Price Under the acquisition method of accounting, the identifiable assets acquired and liabilities assumed were recognized at their estimated acquisition-date fair values, with the excess of the consideration transferred over the fair value of the identifiable net assets acquired recognized as goodwill. Goodwill is primarily attributable to the assembled workforce and expected synergies and other future economic benefits. Goodwill is not deductible for tax purposes.
